sources.title: Google — Email sender guidelines
sources.claim_scope: Personal Gmail sender authentication, bulk requirements, alignment and unsubscribe
sources.evidence_summary: Official primary page directly retrieved; summarizes current published requirements.

sources.title: Yahoo Sender Hub — FAQs
sources.claim_scope: Unsubscribe processing deadline and distinct provider policy
sources.evidence_summary: Official indexed FAQ says unsubscribe requests must be honored within two days. Both FAQ and best-practices direct retrieval returned errors/429; exact policy must be reverified before implementation.

sources.title: Resend — Acceptable Use Policy
sources.claim_scope: Opt-in, prohibited unsolicited outreach and provider sending-statistics conditions
sources.evidence_summary: Directly retrieved policy prohibits cold outreach, purchased lists and scraped contacts; explicit opt-in; complaint below 0.08% and bounce below 4%.

sources.title: Resend — Idempotency Keys
sources.claim_scope: Supported deduplication keys and finite retention window
sources.evidence_summary: Directly retrieved provider documentation states 24-hour retention and repeated-request deduplication.

sources.title: LinkedIn — Posts API
sources.claim_scope: Organization/member publishing scopes, supported formats, headers and response identifiers
sources.evidence_summary: October 2026 version directly retrieved; requires version headers; distinct organization/member permissions and role conditions.

sources.title: Meta — Facebook Pages API
sources.evidence_summary: Official indexed content identifies pages_manage_posts; direct retrieval failed/429. Exact integration requirements must be freshly checked.

sources.title: Meta — Instagram Content Publishing
sources.claim_scope: Capability-level distinction between login paths and publishing scope families
sources.evidence_summary: Official indexed content distinguishes Instagram Login and Facebook Login permission sets; direct retrieval failed. No fixed limits inferred.

sources.title: LinkedIn — Getting Access to LinkedIn APIs
sources.claim_scope: Product access and permission scope distinctions
sources.evidence_summary: Official documentation distinguishes self-service member share scope from restricted product and organization capabilities.

limitations: Meta official documentation was available in search-index excerpts but not through direct full-page retrieval; implementation gates require fresh primary verification.
Dynamic provider policies and versioned APIs can change after retrieval.
Frameworks and operating policies are original synthesis; hypothetical examples are not empirical benchmarks.
No live ClimbOS integrations or customer outcome experiments were executed.
Yahoo FAQ was supported by official indexed content; direct retrieval returned 429. Book explicitly avoids unsupported exact bulk-volume definitions.
